# Psalm 61 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 61:1 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** For-the-choirmaster. On-stringed-instruments. Of-David.
- **LOGOS:** For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. Of David.
- **PNEUMA:** For the music director. To be accompanied by stringed instruments. A psalm of David.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 61:3 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** From-the-end of-the-earth I-call to-You when-my-heart faints; to-a-rock higher than-I lead-me.
- **LOGOS:** from the end of the earth I call to You when my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I,
- **PNEUMA:** From the ends of the earth, I cry to You for help when my heart is overwhelmed. Lead me to the towering rock of safety,

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 61:7 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Days upon the-days of-the-king You-will-add; his-years [will be] as-generation and-generation.
- **LOGOS:** Prolong the life of the king; may his years span many generations.
- **PNEUMA:** Add many years to the life of the king! May his years span the generations!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 61:5 (overlap: 6%)

- **EMET:** I-will-dwell in-Your-tent forever; I-will-take-refuge in-the-shelter of-Your-wings. Selah.
- **LOGOS:** Let me dwell in Your tent forever! Let me take refuge under the shelter of Your wings! Selah.
- **PNEUMA:** Let me live forever in Your sanctuary, safe beneath the shelter of Your wings! Pause and reflect.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 61:8 (overlap: 7%)

- **EMET:** He-will-sit forever before God; steadfast-love and-truth appoint to-guard-him.
- **LOGOS:** May he be enthroned forever before God; appoint steadfast love and faithfulness to watch over him!
- **PNEUMA:** May he reign under God's protection forever. May Your unfailing love and faithfulness watch over him.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 61:4 (overlap: 8%)

- **EMET:** For You-have-been a-refuge for-me, a-tower of-strength from-the-face of-the-enemy.
- **LOGOS:** for You have been my refuge, a strong tower against the enemy.
- **PNEUMA:** for You are my safe refuge, a fortress where my enemies cannot reach me.
